interface.name: banana_retro_manager_v1
interface.description: An opt-in protocol for the native software runtime. Other surfaces keep their ordinary Wayland presentation behavior.

entry.name: xrgb8888_shm
entry.summary: active presenter accepts native XRGB8888 SHM

entry.name: invalid_surface
entry.summary: surface cannot start a native session

entry.name: unsupported
entry.summary: active presenter cannot present native SHM

request.name: get_surface
request.description: Associate this object with a newly constructed xdg_toplevel before its initial empty commit. Each wl_surface can host one native session.

event.name: capabilities
event.description: Sent once on binding. A client must receive xrgb8888_shm before starting a session.

entry.name: invalid_frame
entry.summary: invalid buffer, geometry or initial configure

request.name: set_geometry

description.summary: set the geometry of the next buffer commit

request.description: Send once before each XRGB8888 SHM buffer commit. The aspect is the unrotated display aspect. Rotation counts counterclockwise quarter turns, from zero through three, relative to the game image.

event.name: first_presented

description.summary: a frame from this session completed a display flip

event.description: Sent at most once, after a successful KMS page flip, before the matching wl_surface.frame callback is completed. The timestamp is the compositor's monotonic time, in milliseconds, at flip dispatch.

event.name: frame_failed
event.description: This commit did not flip. A client may continue submitting frames.

description.summary: the session surface has been lost
